Application Data.NAME: Grace Community Church
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Grace Community Church operates as a religious organization dedicated to serving the community through various programs. We conduct regular worship services, host educational activities, and engage in charitable outreach efforts. Our facilities are also utilized for community events, including holiday celebrations, potluck dinners, and youth gatherings. We emphasize safety and adhere to local regulations, ensuring a secure environment for all attendees. Our volunteer staff plays a vital role in our operations, providing support for events and activities while following established safety protocols.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 04/15/2023, a slip-and-fall incident occurred during a community potluck event due to a wet floor, resulting in a claim of $2,500. The claim was reported, and the church is currently working with the affected party to resolve it amicably. Status: Open.
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security personnel on-site during events, 24-hour monitoring system, and perimeter fencing around the premises.
